lock.name: repo.lock
lock.authority: regular readable-writable non-symlink file; every Controller mutation and the Git Finalizer retirement path serialize on it; missing or unusable locks fail closed

directories.records: one metadata record JSON per allocation id
directories.bindings: one worktree-key binding JSON per governed checkout
directories.transactions: nonterminal mutation journals; interrupted atomic temp siblings are never records
directories.namespace-migrations: write-once legacy namespace migration receipts, keyed by plan id
directories.registration-prune-receipts: write-once registration-prune/v1 audit receipts; authoritative terminal and recovery proof for registration pruning, not repository identity or lock authority; included byte-for-byte in namespace migration merged digest and move/convergence, but not in the prior GC plan digest or metadata-reference-relocation/v1 cleanup inventory
directories.branch-retirement-plans: versioned retirement plans consumed by the Git Finalizer retirement verifier
directories.branch-retirement-authorizations: single-use retirement execution grants and their immutable abandonment evidence

consumers: Git Finalizer retirement verifier (reads branch-retirement-plans under repo.lock)
compatibility: v4 declares exactly one directory (registration-prune-receipts) already used by 1.9.2; no data moves and all v3 names, file identities and record schemas remain unchanged; v3 readers of existing paths may ignore the extra directory, while exact layout pins must recognize v4 before activation; v3 adds exactly one directory (namespace-migrations) and one documented previous-namespace entry (codex-worktree/v1, migrated only by the namespace-migrate verb); v2 adds exactly one directory (branch-retirement-authorizations); any further layout or schema change requires a new layout version plus that gate, and external consumers pin this section
